records.title: How to write copy that actually converts

expressions.meaning_zh: 关于……有一点要说/问题是
expressions.example: Here's the thing about remote work: it's not for everyone.
Lead with your strongest argument.
If the thumbnail isn't catchy, people will scroll straight past.

expressions.meaning_zh: 去掉那些流行但空洞的术语
expressions.example: In your resume, cut the buzzwords and use concrete examples.
A good ad names the pain before offering the cure.

grammar_points: Here's the thing about... 用来引出话题或重点的常用口语结构
if 条件句 + 一般将来时（will scroll）表示可能的结果

key_sentences.text: Here's the thing about copywriting.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 关于文案写作，有一点要说。

key_sentences.text: Most people write about the product, but they should be writing about the problem.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 大多数人写的是产品，但他们应该写的是问题。

key_sentences.text: If your headline doesn't name the pain your reader already feels, they will scroll straight past it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你的标题没有点明读者已经感受到的痛点，他们就会直接滑过去。

key_sentences.text: So lead with the problem, then show the solution.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 所以先点明问题，再展示解决方案。

key_sentences.text: And please, cut the buzzwords.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 还有，请去掉那些空洞的流行术语。

result.summary_zh: 这段短视频讲解了撰写高转化率落地页文案的核心技巧：先点明用户痛点，再展示解决方案，并避免使用空洞的流行术语。

records.title: Why most startups fail in year two

result.subtopic: 创业失败教训与早期验证

expressions.text: the writing was on the wall
expressions.meaning_zh: （不祥的）征兆早已显现，败象已露
expressions.example: The writing was on the wall months before the company shut down.

expressions.meaning_zh: 把 A 误认为 B
expressions.example: Don't mistake politeness for genuine interest.

expressions.text: chase a market that didn't exist yet
expressions.meaning_zh: 追逐一个尚不存在的市场
expressions.example: They were chasing a market that didn't exist yet.

expressions.meaning_zh: 极其坦诚，毫不留情地说实话
expressions.example: We need to be brutally honest about our numbers.
Our savings shrank month after month.

grammar_points: 过去完成进行时（We were chasing）表示过去某段时间持续的动作，常用来描述背景或原因
before 引导时间状语从句，表示“在……之前”，注意主句用一般现在时、从句也用一般现在时（before you write）
祈使句用于给出建议（Talk to..., be brutally honest...）

key_sentences.text: We raised a seed round, hired too fast, and then watched the runway shrink month after month.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我们融了种子轮，招人太快，然后眼看着资金跑道一个月一个月地缩短。

key_sentences.text: Looking back, the writing was on the wall long before we admitted it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 回头看，早在我们承认之前，败象就已经显现了。

key_sentences.text: We were chasing a market that didn't exist yet, and we mistook early enthusiasm for real demand.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我们当时在追逐一个尚不存在的市场，还把早期的热情误当成了真实需求。

key_sentences.text: Talk to twenty customers before you write a single line of code, and be brutally honest about what you hear.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 在写第一行代码之前，先去和二十个客户聊聊，并且对你听到的东西要极其坦诚。

result.summary_zh: 作者分享了自己创业失败的教训：融资后招人过快、资金跑道不断缩短，追逐不存在的市场，把早期热情误当需求。建议在写代码前先与二十个客户交谈，并诚实面对反馈。

records.title: Fine-tuning vs prompting, explained simply

result.subtopic: 提示词工程与模型微调的区别

expressions.example: Let's start with the basics before we dive into the details.
This method is fast; on the other hand, it can be less accurate.

grammar_points: 祈使句与 let's 开头的建议句式（Let's start with... / always try...）
if 引导的条件状语从句（If you can describe..., prompt it.）
on the other hand 作为对比连接词的使用

key_sentences.text: Prompting means you keep the model as it is and describe what you want in plain language.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 提示意味着你保持模型不变，用通俗的语言描述你想要什么。

key_sentences.text: Fine-tuning, on the other hand, means you show the model hundreds of examples and let it adjust its own weights.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 而微调则意味着你给模型展示数百个例子，让它调整自己的权重。

key_sentences.text: If you can describe the task in a paragraph, prompt it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你能用一段话描述这个任务，就用提示。

key_sentences.text: If you need the model to imitate a very specific house style, then it is worth fine-tuning.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你需要模型模仿一种非常特定的内部风格，那么微调是值得的。

key_sentences.text: And one more thing, always try prompting first, because it is dramatically cheaper.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 还有一点，总是先尝试提示，因为它便宜得多。

records.title: This changed my mindset

expressions.example: Instead of trying to fix everything at once, fix one small thing today.

expressions.meaning_zh: 让那件小事保持解决状态
expressions.example: Once you fix it, keep that small thing fixed.
Every time you keep a promise to yourself, you build trust.
When you decide to do something, do not negotiate with yourself.
Following through shows that your word means something.

grammar_points: 一般将来时与情态动词：'You are not going to fix...' 与 'What you can do is...' 的对比，表达否定预测与可行方案。
表语从句与主语从句：'That is how order gets built' 和 'every small promise you keep to yourself is evidence that your word means something'，其中 that 引导同位语从句。
祈使句：'pick something almost trivial, and then do not negotiate with yourself about it.' 用于给出直接建议。

key_sentences.text: You are not going to fix your life in one afternoon.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你不可能在一个下午就解决你人生中的所有问题。

key_sentences.text: What you can do is fix one small thing today, and then keep that small thing fixed.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你能做的是今天解决一件小事，然后让那件小事保持解决状态。

key_sentences.text: That is how order gets built, incrementally, and it is also how confidence gets built, because every small promise you keep to yourself is evidence that your word means something.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 秩序就是这样逐步建立起来的，信心也是如此，因为每一个你对自己遵守的小承诺，都是你的话有分量的证据。

key_sentences.text: So pick something almost trivial, and then do not negotiate with yourself about it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 所以，选一件几乎微不足道的事，然后不要和自己讨价还价。

result.summary_zh: 这段演讲强调通过坚持完成小事来逐步建立秩序和自信，建议选择一件微不足道的事并坚决执行，不要自我妥协。

records.title: How I stopped overthinking everything

expressions.example: We kept going around in circles and never made a decision.
Taking a walk helps me break the loop of negative thoughts.
Nine times out of ten, the problem solves itself.
Comparing yourself to others is a trap.

grammar_points: What broke the loop for me was... 强调句（what 从句作主语，突出真正起作用的东西）

key_sentences.translation_zh: 过度思考感觉很有用，而这正是陷阱。

key_sentences.text: You convince yourself you are solving a problem, when really you are just going around in circles.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你说服自己正在解决问题，而实际上你只是在原地打转。

key_sentences.text: What broke the loop for me was a stupidly simple question.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 打破我这种循环的，是一个简单到愚蠢的问题。

key_sentences.text: Nine times out of ten, it takes two minutes, and the spiral is gone.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 十有八九，它只需要两分钟，然后那种螺旋式的焦虑就消失了。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频指出过度思考的陷阱，并分享了一个打破循环的简单方法：问自己下一个具体的物理动作是什么。

records.title: Interview: what nobody says about success

expressions.example: That's what people get wrong about learning a language.
The reality of the job is far more mundane than the movies suggest.
Success is a series of small decisions.
The cumulative effect of daily practice is huge.

expressions.meaning_zh: 一夜成名 / 一夜成功
expressions.example: Most overnight successes take years.
You can't shortcut the process.

grammar_points: the thing people get wrong about success is that... 中 that 引导表语从句，说明主语的具体内容
It is a series of unremarkable days in which you did not quit 中 in which 引导定语从句修饰 days，相当于 when
There is no version of this where the work happens without you 中 where 引导定语从句修饰 version，表示“在这种情形下”

key_sentences.text: I think the thing people get wrong about success is that they imagine it as a moment.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我认为人们对成功最大的误解，就是把它想象成一个瞬间。

key_sentences.text: It is a series of unremarkable days in which you did not quit, and the cumulative effect of that, frankly, is what people later call overnight success.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 它是一连串你未曾放弃的平凡日子，而坦率地说，正是这些日子的累积效应，后来被人们称为一夜成功。

key_sentences.text: The uncomfortable corollary is that you cannot shortcut it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 令人不安的推论是：你无法走捷径。

key_sentences.text: There is no version of this where the work happens without you.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 这件事没有任何一种版本，能让努力绕开你而发生。

result.summary_zh: 这段采访片段指出，成功不是某个瞬间，而是由无数个没有放弃的平凡日子累积而成，所谓一夜成功不过是这种累积的结果，且无法走捷径。

records.title: Why you should learn English with stories

result.subtopic: 用故事记单词 vs 背单词表

expressions.meaning_zh: 关于……是这样的（用来引出重点的口语开场语）
expressions.example: Here is the thing about learning a language: consistency matters more than talent.

expressions.meaning_zh: 你真正在意的（actually 在这里表示“真正地”，起强调作用）
expressions.example: Read books you actually care about, not ones you think you should read.

expressions.meaning_zh: 把……归入（某类别）；在脑中归档
expressions.example: I file these notes under 'urgent'.
I walk to work instead of taking the bus.

expressions.meaning_zh: 而不是（比 instead of 更正式，常用于书面和正式口语）
expressions.example: She chose to study rather than go out.
I can tolerate the noise, but not for long.

grammar_points: 祈使句 + and + 结果：You memorise fifty words, and by Friday you remember maybe six of them.
if 引导的真实条件句 + 一般现在时：if those same fifty words appear inside a story you actually care about, your brain files them...
rather than 连接并列的不定式（to read one page... rather than ten pages...）

key_sentences.text: Here is the thing about vocabulary lists.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 关于单词表，情况是这样的。

key_sentences.text: You memorise fifty words, and by Friday you remember maybe six of them.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你背了五十个单词，到周五可能只记得其中六个。

key_sentences.text: But if those same fifty words appear inside a story you actually care about, your brain files them under meaning instead of under homework.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 但如果这同样的五十个单词出现在你真正在意的故事里，你的大脑就会把它们归档在“意义”之下，而不是“作业”之下。
